# Paths whose CodeQL results are dropped before upload (see .github/workflows/codeql.yml).
#
# One regular expression per line, matched from the start of the repository-relative path.
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
#
# This list exists because `paths-ignore` in codeql-config.yml has no effect on Go: Go is analysed
# from a build, and CodeQL only honours path filters for languages it scans without building.

# Deliberately vulnerable training targets: the vulnerabilities are the product.
common/vulinbox/

# Mock servers reproducing SSRF and XSS so that detection code can be tested against them.
common/mockey/

# Vendored third-party code, fixed upstream rather than here.
common/third_party/

# Inputs for the parsers and compilers under test (JavaScript bundles, JSP, Python projects...).
(.*/)?testdata/
(.*/)?tests?/
common/yak/antlr4JS/test\.js$

# Test doubles that are not named *_test.go.
common/rpa/implement/testimple/

# Third-party bot-detection page, embedded verbatim as crawler test data.
embed/data/anti-crawler/
